leads.summary: Quickchat AI builds multilingual AI assistants powered by generative AI models (GPT, Claude) that companies integrate into websites, apps, and messaging platforms for customer support, sales, and helpdesk automation.
leads.hook: Team integrates ChatGPT and Claude as first-class components; platform explicitly supports both models for conversational AI at scale
leads.angle_reason: Both projects leverage LLM APIs as core infrastructure: MedVault uses Gemini prompting pipelines while Quickchat builds on ChatGPT/Claude APIs.

leads.summary: Minicor builds self-healing UI automation APIs that connect AI startups to legacy desktop applications without APIs, providing observability, video replays, and deployment across on-prem, cloud, and Citrix environments.
leads.hook: Explicitly building an MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration layer for AI agents; infrastructure-first approach to connecting AI systems to non-API legacy apps
leads.angle_reason: Both are infrastructure plays: Canopy provides code intelligence and call-graph analysis, Minicor provides UI automation infrastructure for AI agents.

leads.summary: DreamCraft is a no-code game creation platform bundled with a game editor and art assets that enables non-technical users to build, publish, and monetize video games.
leads.hook: Games built on the DreamCraft platform by solo developers have generated millions of organic downloads and millions in revenue

leads.summary: Serif Health builds healthcare price intelligence APIs and data products that aggregate, normalize, and present pricing and reimbursement data to help providers, payers, and benefits organizations understand market costs.
leads.hook: Web platform uses natural language queries ('Ask Signal') to return healthcare pricing insights—combining LLM-driven query understanding with structured data APIs
leads.angle_reason: Both involve healthcare-domain data processing with API-first backends: MedVault parses PDF health documents with LLMs, Serif structures healthcare pricing data into queryable APIs.

leads.summary: REVER is an eCommerce post-sale platform that automates product returns and refunds for online retailers, with integrated logistics, exchange automation, and AI-driven business intelligence on return patterns.
leads.hook: Currently processing 100M€+ in yearly returns volume with 50M€+ in annual revenue; automating complex multi-step workflows at enterprise scale
leads.angle_reason: REVER is production SaaS infrastructure handling at-scale business workflows; Aditya's Basepair internship focused on fixing production distributed-systems bugs and reliability.

leads.summary: RamAIn automates complex UI tasks across web and desktop applications using AI agents that learn from demonstration and are deployed as composable REST APIs with built-in recovery and observability.
leads.hook: 4-person YC startup building managed UI automation APIs deployed at scale; features include credential vaulting, CAPTCHA handling, and network request introspection for robust automation
leads.angle_reason: Both are developer infrastructure: Canopy analyzes code to build call graphs, RamAIn automates repetitive tasks by understanding UI workflows.

leads.summary: Supabase is the Postgres development platform providing integrated database, authentication, storage, edge functions, realtime, and vector search capabilities.
leads.hook: Postgres-first backend platform with integrated Auth and RLS (Row Level Security) policies

leads.summary: Zerodha Tech is the technology division of India's largest stock broker, building and open-sourcing infrastructure tools and services in Go, Python, Rust, and JavaScript used across their fintech ecosystem.
leads.hook: listmonk newsletter platform has 23k+ GitHub stars; active FOSS culture with Zerodha dogfooding projects across their infrastructure (job queues, logging, support desks, task management)
leads.angle_reason: Both involve backend infrastructure and distributed systems: Zerodha builds production-grade infrastructure tools (job servers, queues, observability), Aditya's Basepair work fixed production bugs at scale.

leads.summary: Unsiloed AI builds vision model-based document parsing APIs that convert PDFs, images, and spreadsheets into structured JSON and Markdown, enabling LLM pipelines and AI agents to reason over unstructured enterprise data.
leads.hook: 2-person YC startup with state-of-the-art document parsing—ranked #1 on olmOCR-Bench against Gemini, Mistral, and OpenAI; dual-stream vision model architecture with attention-guided heatmaps
leads.angle_reason: Both involve parsing unstructured documents for LLM consumption: MedVault parses lab report PDFs with Gemini APIs, Unsiloed parses any document type with vision models into LLM-ready formats.

leads.summary: Lumen Labs builds cognitive architectures for physical AI and robotics, developing nature-inspired learning systems for autonomous navigation and control in unstructured environments like construction sites and pipelines.
leads.hook: Pre-seed robotics team achieving zero-shot sim2real transfer with policies running at 100Hz on ESP32; working on physical AI across wheeled robots, drones, and pipeline inspection platforms
